unlisted_practices: Agentic RAG grounding of AI-simulated patient responses in structured clinical context for medical education simulation

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an AI-native virtual hospital simulation platform (AIMAH) using LLMs and agentic RAG for medical trainee education, measuring user perceptions (usability, realism, educational usefulness) without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or guardrail comparative condition.
